messages:
Alice (Support): Escalation: AquaLedger trial hitting intermittent 429s on embeddings and 504s on chat in eu-west-1 after a large dataset ingest. Renewal ~5w out, customer concerned. Need CS takeover.
Tom (CS): Ack, grabbing owner. Can you paste top logs + impacted endpoints?
Alice (Support): Log excerpt: ```2026-03-08T09:12:03Z inference ERROR model=redwood-small status=504 route=/chat/generate user=aqualedger-org
RateLimiter: embeddings quota_exceeded user=aqualedger-org limit=1000/day current=1124```
Alice (Support): Impacted routes: /chat/generate (~85%), /embeddings/create (~15%). Spike started 2026-03-07 ~22:00 UTC after bulk import.
Priya (SE): Quick mitigations: 1) staged region failover (us-east-1) for a subset, 2) enable KV prefix cache for hot prompts, 3) temporary trial embed quota bump. Example route override: ```routes:
- id: aqualedger-temp
  match: org:aqualedger
  region: us-east-1
  kv_cache: true
  batch_size: 6```
Tom (CS): Draft comms plan: owner Tom (CS) + Priya; audience: engineering + procurement; message: incident summary + immediate mitigations + ETA for fix; timing: initial customer note within 90m, technical call <24h; risk: MED-HIGH (renewal in 5w).
Maya (CS Manager): Recommend offering an enablement session and a one-time quota bump. Sales: prep a short extension offer if instability extends >72h.
Priya (SE): I'll prepare runbook + enablement slides. Proposed enablement: Wed 09:00 UTC or Thu 15:00 UTC.
Tom (CS): Booked Wed 09:00 UTC. Customer script (short): "Hi Lee — we detected an ingest surge impacting EU. We've initiated a staged failover and enabled caching. Can we do a 30-min call Wed 09:00 UTC? We'll pause renewal steps until stability confirmed"
sre-bot: [alert] monitoring.aqualedger.eu-west-1 spikes: https://monitoring.redwood.internal/alerts/3399
Alice (Support): Rolled 10% traffic to us-east-1; that cohort latency down ~35% after 15m. Will expand to 50% if stable.
Tom (CS): Action items: Alice expand routing if stable (owner Alice); Priya: runbook + slides (owner Priya); Tom: send invite + notify sales (owner Tom). We'll capture a 3-question pulse after the call: satisfaction (1-5), clarity (yes/no), further asks (free text).
